description: Vercel's data hook library based on stale-while-revalidate. `useSWR(key, fetcher)` plus `mutate` for revalidation.
Data fetching layer in Redux Toolkit. `createApi` generates hooks; tags drive cache invalidation.
A query language and typed schema served from one endpoint. Clients choose the exact fields they receive.
Cache storing entities once by type and id (Apollo, Relay, urql Graphcache) so updates propagate to every query.
A reusable selection of GraphQL fields. Relay co-locates fragments with components and composes them into queries.
Type-safe remote procedure calls between a TypeScript server and client, built on TanStack Query in React.
